All the beautiful paintings which filled the galleries--valued at that day at £80,000--have disappeared, and the whole place is crumbling into dust. No sum short of £100,000 would make the place habitable. Lord Byron's few apartments contain some modern upholstery, but serve only to show what ought to have been there.
